==Usage==
To use this template, paste <code><nowiki>{{UserContributed|</nowiki>{{Var|years}}<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code> into your user page. To specify a number of months instead, use <code><nowiki>{{UserContributed</nowiki>{{Para|months|{{Var|months}}}}<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>.
